# DISCOGRAPHY [italic]Every release, oldest first. All albums on cassette. Some on the relay. One on a hard drive that Dmitri will not let anyone see.[/italic]
## COLD STORAGE (2178) [italic]Recorded in a refrigerated cargo container at the Titan methane docks, because it was the only quiet room for six kilometres.[/italic] - Methane Kids - Dock Lights - Cold Storage - Ninety Minutes to Saturn - Lost in the Manifest
The first pressing was forty tapes, handed out at the dock gate. One sold at a Gateway auction last year for more than Kaito's synthesizer cost.
## NINETY MINUTES FROM HOME (2181) [italic]The breakthrough. The title is the length of a standard service cassette, and the length of the playlist every colonist packs for the trip out.[/italic] - Wake Me at Gateway - Neon Over Titan - Relay Delay - Signal Lost - Ration Card Romance - The Long Way Round the Veil
Signal Lost is the one people ask about. Lux wrote it for a friend whose colony stopped answering the relay. She will not say which colony. The song ends on a carrier tone that just keeps going.
## AFTERGLOW PROTOCOL (2183) [italic]The new one. Written in transit, recorded on Gateway, mixed in a hotel room on Mars at four in the morning.[/italic] - Hypersleep Heart - Afterglow Protocol - Processor Hum - Every Light on Gateway - Synthetic Love Song - Do You Dream, Joe - Wake Me When We Get There
Do You Dream, Joe is about a Working Joe on a night shift. Seegson has asked the band to clarify that Working Joes do not dream. The band has thanked Seegson for clarifying.
## LIVE RECORDINGS - [bold]Live at the Huygens Dome[/bold], 2182. Recorded on a borrowed tape deck from the sound desk. The crowd sings the whole of Neon Over Titan without the band.
